Headline: CandyDrop 193rd: CandyDrop x World Liberty Financial (WLFI) , Trade and Invite Friends to Share 906,...

Smallest threshold (parsed): 500 USD (trade)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
CandyDrop is Gate’s candy airdrop platform where users complete tasks to earn candies and share token airdrops. We are excited to launch the WLFI token airdrop event, where you can complete the following tasks to earn candies and share a total prize pool of 906,120 WLFI, with a maximum individual share of 3,000 WLFI.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 23, 2026, 10:00 – December 3, 2026, 10:00 (UTC)
*Trading Volume Note: Only eligible Token/USD1 pairs count toward this campaign; USDT/USD1 and USDC/USD1 are excluded.
## 1.Spot Trade Prize Pool Rules
Users spot trade on Gate, with any USD1 spot trading pair (excluding USDT and USDC), achieving a spot trading volume ≥ 1,000 USD1, will earn 1 candy. The total reward pool is 700,000 WLFI. Maximum per user: 2,000 WLFI. The reward rule is as follows:
Volume of spot trade ≥ 1,000 USD1: 1 Candy
Volume of spot trade ≥ 3,000 USD1: 3 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 5,000 USD1: 5 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 7,000 USD1: 7 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 15,000 USD1: 20 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 30,000 USD1: 40 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 50,000 USD1: 60 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 80,000 USD1: 80 Candies
## 2.Invite Friends Prize Pool Rules
During the event, for every successful invitation of 1 valid friend (who registers and completes ≥ 500 USD1 spot trading), you can receive 1 Candy, with a maximum of 10 Candies. All Candy holders will share a prize pool of 206,120 WLFI, with a maximum reward of 1,000 WLFI per person.
Note: To qualify as a valid referral, users must register through the exclusive event link and complete ≥500 USD1 in spot trading pair (excluding USDT and USDC). Referrals who have participated in other invitation campaigns will not be eligible for candy rewards at this event.
## Project Introduction
World Liberty Financial $WLFI is a governance token powering a DeFi protocol dedicated to promoting USD-based stablecoins and preserving the U.S. Dollar’s global dominance. Built to keep the dollar digital—reliable, global, and stable—WLFI bridges Web2 and Web3, offering fast, fair, and frictionless access to capital for both institutions and everyday users.
Token : WLFI
Official Website: https://worldlibertyfinancial.com/
X: https://x.com/worldlibertyfi
## Notes
Participants must click the “Join Now” button on the event page. After successfully joining the event, they must complete the event tasks and identity verification to receive rewards.
Rewards will be distributed to users’ accounts within 14 working days after the end of the event.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person’s identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
Market makers, enterprises, and institutions are not allowed to participate in this event. Agent accounts cannot participate in friend-invitation type activities, while other activities are unrestricted.
In case of any discrepancies between the translated version and the English version, the English version shall prevail.
Gate has the final interpretation rights for this event.
Users in restricted areas cannot access all or part of the services (including participating in this event, game, or competition). For more information about restricted areas, please read User Agreement.
